messages:
emily: quick copy sanity check for the "Session restore" toast that appears after a browser crash. want it to be reassuring and clear about what will be restored. current copy: \"Restore previous session?\" with button \"Restore\" and \"Dismiss\".

emily: worry: too terse, and 'Restore' could be unclear (restore what?). also need to consider autosession privacy: are we restoring unsaved prompts?

rishi: agree. make it explicit and friendly. suggestion:
"Restore your previous session"
Body (small): "We can reopen your last workspace, including unsaved prompts and open tabs."
Primary: "Restore session"
Secondary: "No thanks"

kate: small accessibility nit: avoid contractions like "No thanks" for confirm/decline because screen readers may need clarity. maybe use "Dismiss" or "Keep closed"? also include aria-describedby pointing to details link.

emily: good point. how about Primary: "Restore previous session" Secondary: "Dismiss"? and add tiny line: "We’ll only restore content from this browser and device."

rishi: yea that helps privacy concerns. for tone, lead with benefit: "Pick up where you left off" as the headline, then the detail line.

emily: try full suggestion:
Title: "Pick up where you left off"
Body (small): "Restore your previous session (open tabs and unsaved prompts) on this device."
Primary: "Restore session"
Secondary: "Dismiss"

kate: love the headline. accessibility request: set primary aria-label to "Restore previous session, including unsaved prompts" and ensure toast is keyboard-focusable when it appears. also add a short data-attribute so devs can instrument analytics for 'restore accepted' vs 'dismissed'.

ux-bot: UX checklist: toasts with destructive or privacy-affecting actions should include an undo window or confirmation modal if there is risk. consider keeping toast non-destructive and offer full restore from the Sessions page.

emily: thanks all  i'll wire this into Figma and add the aria-labels + analytics hook in the ticket. unless objections, will push to PM for sign-off. :sparkles:

rishi: :thumbsup:

kate: :+1:
